message: So, there I was, just your average Tuesday, when I realized I had a smoke alarm in every room—yes, even the bathroom! 😅 My family lovingly teases me for being the gloriously over-prepared one, but you know what? It gives me peace of mind. I mean, it’s always better to be safe than sorry, right? Plus, it led us to create a fun family escape plan that includes ‘the Great Pillow Race’ to the backyard. Who says safety can’t be a little silly?
